basics.name: Lorenzo Graizzaro
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with hands-on projects in React, TypeScript, React Native, Kotlin/Spring Boot, NestJS, Python/FastAPI, and AWS serverless — all containerized or deployed in production. Work experience in high-demand environments and production SQL data management. Detail-oriented, capable of working autonomously and integrating quickly into agile teams.

work.name: UNSAM

Debugging and code review of academic projects in team settings

Accounting management with Xubio: checks, transfers, and inventory control

work.name: Banco Nación

projects.name: StudyQuest
projects.description: Full-stack study platform with AI-generated quizzes and user matching system. Modular backend with NestJS and PostgreSQL, reproducible environment with Docker Compose.
highlights: Modular NestJS API with containerized PostgreSQL/Redis
AI-powered PDF/DOCX to interactive quiz conversion

projects.name: BookLibre
projects.description: Book lending and reservation system with availability and user management. Fully Dockerized full-stack with polyglot persistence. Deployed to production: API on Render, frontend on GitHub Pages.
highlights: Dockerized full-stack with Docker Compose (local) and Render + GitHub Pages (production)
Polyglot persistence: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis
JWT auth with HttpOnly cookies and SameSite=None for cross-origin auth between different domains

projects.name: FraudDetector
projects.description: Banking fraud detection tool that processes 100k+ transactions using 3-model ML consensus and visualizes risk in an interactive dashboard.
highlights: Ensemble of Isolation Forest, LOF, and K-Means: a client is flagged as risk only if ≥ 2 models agree (~35% fewer false positives)
Interactive Plotly dashboard: scatter plots and boxplots for per-client risk distribution
REST API with response times of 110–150 ms per client analysis and 40–60 ms per transaction

projects.name: ServerlessScanner
projects.description: AWS architecture analysis tool that detects serverless migration opportunities in CloudFormation templates and estimates potential cost savings.
highlights: Analyzes CloudFormation resources (EC2, RDS, ECS) and recommends serverless equivalents (Lambda, Aurora Serverless, DynamoDB)
Deployed to AWS Lambda with API Gateway using AWS SAM

projects.name: Prioria
projects.description: Android app that intercepts system notifications, prioritizes them with an AI agent, and announces them via voice through Amazon Polly. 100% serverless AWS backend.
highlights: Serverless agent with Strands Agents SDK + Amazon Bedrock: prioritizes notifications based on user rules and preferences
AWS serverless backend: Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, DynamoDB, SQS — infrastructure as code with AWS SAM
Automatic TTS via Amazon Polly and native Android widget with explicit feedback for agent refinement
